Store exposure midpoint and half-exposure. Vega system inferred per Swift/UVOT calibration convention (Breeveld et al. 2011). The circular also reports a full-sequence uvot-white coadd upper limit; this first-FC product may share the FC frame with that coadd and is not statistically independent.

GCN 33282: combined last two 180-s R frames; GCN gives mid-time ~17.57 h after trigger (approximately +63252 s) and reports R>20.95 AB. Stored epoch +63309 s (04:05:00 UT) is consistent within ~1 min with the approximate GCN time; time_err=180 s (half of the 360-s combined exposure). The circular says “six exposures” but lists 5×20+60+120+2×180 s (9 frames; 640 s total); value and epoch refer to combined last two frames. Pan-STARRS calibration; the circular does not state the confidence level.

GCN 33286: absolute UTC window 2023-02-06 11:51–12:23 UT; window midpoint is +92229 s and half-span is 960 s. GCN also states 25.20–25.52 h, corresponding to 2023-02-06 11:41:51–12:01:03 UT; this is earlier than the explicit 11:51–12:23 UT window, with midpoints differing by about 15.6 min. Use the explicit UTC window. Three 300-s exposures per band; no detection within enhanced XRT region. Limit not extinction-corrected; GCN does not state confidence level. GCN does not declare the magnitude system; kept blank.

Retained for audit, discard=y. Observation epoch only stated as about +2.5 d; use the approximate midpoint and ±0.05 d precision uncertainty.
